From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@novastream.io>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Quick product walkthrough — NovaStream trial

Hi Emma,

Thanks for signing up for the Redwood trial — I’m Sofia on the SDR team and I’ll be your point of contact. I saw you picked a slot for a 30-minute walkthrough today at 3:00pm PT. I’ve attached the invite (meeting.ics) and a one-pager to give a quick overview.

Agenda (30 minutes):
- Quick intro + objectives (5m)
- Live walkthrough of the inference dashboard and Dedicated options (15m)
- Next steps & deployment considerations (10m)

If anything changes or you'd prefer a 15-minute quick sync instead, reply here and I’ll squeeze you in.

Attachments: meeting.ics (calendar invite)

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform

Subject: Missed demo — quick recovery options

Hi Emma —

We missed you for the walkthrough earlier. No worries — I know schedules get busy. Quick options to keep momentum: 

1) 15-minute QuickSync today or tomorrow (I can send a 15m slot).
2) Short async walkthrough — I’ll send a recorded 8–10 minute clip and a checklist so your engineering lead can review on their own time.
3) If you prefer, I can loop in our AE (Jonas) for a 20-minute technical audit tailored to your trial goals.

Also attaching a brief one-pager that highlights performance & deployment patterns customers use when they move from trial to Dedicated capacity.

Which option works best for you? If 1), what timezone works — happy to propose two micro-slots.

Attachments: redwood-demo-onepager.pdf

Thanks,
Sofia
